An anchor wrapping a block that holds another anchor records its destination once, not twice

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"/o\"><div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
